description: Figure 4.1 presents five line plots arranged in a grid, each illustrating the Word Error Rate (WER) over six training epochs during fine-tuning of different-sized Whisper models — tiny, base, small, medium, and large — under various weight quantization and adaptation strategies. All plots share a common x-axis labeled “epoch,” ranging from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks, and a y-axis labeled “WER,” scaled differently per plot to accommodate the model’s performance range. In the top-left plot (“Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny”), five lines represent: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (gray solid line with circles), “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” (gray dashed line with squares), “tiny int4” (gray dash-dot line with diamonds), “tiny int8” (gray dotted line with triangles), and “tiny full” (gray dotted line with upward-pointing triangles). WER starts above 60 for most methods at epoch 0 and generally declines to between 22 and 40 by epoch 6, with “tiny full” consistently achieving the lowest WER. The top-right plot (“type = base”) shows five blue lines: “base AdaLoRA_int4” (solid with circles), “base AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed with squares), “base int4” (dash-dot with diamonds), “base int8” (dotted with triangles), and “base full” (dotted with upward-pointing triangles). WER begins near 60 and drops to between 20 and 40 by epoch 6, with “base full” again performing best. The bottom-left plot (“type = small”) displays four orange lines: “small AdaLoRA_int4” (solid with circles), “small AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed with squares), “small int4” (dash-dot with diamonds), and “small int8” (dotted with triangles). WER starts around 30–35, peaks at epoch 2 for some lines (up to ~42), then declines to 25–31 by epoch 6. The bottom-right plot (“type = medium”) shows four green lines: “medium AdaLoRA_int4” (solid with circles), “medium AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed with squares), “medium int4” (dash-dot with diamonds), and “medium int8” (dotted with triangles). WER begins around 25–30, peaks at epoch 1 for some (up to ~36), then steadily declines to 15–21 by epoch 6. The bottom-center plot (“type = large”) contains four purple lines: “large AdaLoRA_int4” (solid with circles), “large AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed with squares), “large int4” (dash-dot with diamonds), and “large int8” (dotted with triangles). WER starts around 25–27, peaks at epoch 2 for some (up to ~32), then declines to 10–19 by epoch 6. Across all plots, the “full” variant (where available) and “AdaLoRA” methods generally outperform the “int4” and “int8” quantized-only approaches, with performance improving as model size increases.
